RCBEAMCHKRATIO.description: RC Beam Checking Ratio (RCBEAMCHKRATIO). Business-logic endpoint that takes no request input; it reads the current model's analysis results and returns per-section and per-element RC beam design checking ratios (top/bottom moment and shear at the I, M, J sectors). Requires an open project with completed analysis results; the concrete design code SP 63.13330.2018 is not supported.

Argument.description: No request body is required (empty DTO).
